description: SEC bankruptcy risk (Ohlson, Zmijewski, Springate) — Bankruptcy and financial-distress screen for any US-listed company from its 10-K XBRL data, using three academic models: Ohlson O-score with probability, Zmijewski X-score (probit) and Springate S-score. Returns each model's value and zone (SAFE/ELEVATED/DISTRESS), a consensus risk LOW/MODERATE/HIGH with confidence, a 4-year trend (IMPROVING/STABLE/WORSENING) and the balance-sheet inputs used. Complements the Altman Z in /v1/sec/fscore. Screening signal only, not a credit rating. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_bankruptcy_risk
